projects.name: LegacyShop.Core
projects.recommendedTarget: Remove System.Web dependencies, then multi-target net48;net10.0 (or netstandard2.0).

findings.title: Entity Framework EDMX model (database-first designer)
findings.guidance: EF6 (6.4+) runs on modern .NET, but the EDMX designer does not. Short term: keep EF6 with code-based configuration. Long term: reverse-engineer to EF Core.

findings.title: BinaryFormatter / NetDataContractSerializer
findings.guidance: BinaryFormatter is removed from .NET 9+. Replace with System.Text.Json, DataContractSerializer or MessagePack. Check persisted data that was serialized with it.

findings.title: System.Web used in a non-web library
findings.guidance: Remove System.Web dependencies from business libraries (abstractions for request/user/cache) so they can multi-target net48 and net10.0.

findings.title: HttpContext.Current (static access)
findings.guidance: Inject IHttpContextAccessor or pass the needed values explicitly. In shared libraries this is often the biggest hidden cost.

findings.title: Legacy (non-SDK) project format
findings.guidance: Convert to SDK-style csproj (by hand or with Microsoft's upgrade tooling). Do this first; it makes every later step easier and can be done while still targeting net48.

findings.title: Targets an old .NET Framework version (< 4.7.2)
findings.guidance: Retarget to net48 first. It gives netstandard2.0 compatibility and lets you share libraries with the new .NET app during an incremental migration.

findings.title: Entity Framework 6
findings.guidance: EF 6.4+ runs on modern .NET. Upgrade the package first and migrate to EF Core later as a separate step to reduce risk.

findings.title: ConfigurationManager / web.config appSettings
findings.guidance: Either add System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager package (quick) or move to IConfiguration/Options (recommended for web apps).

findings.title: packages.config NuGet format
findings.guidance: Migrate to PackageReference (Visual Studio: right-click packages.config → Migrate; not offered for ASP.NET web projects, convert those by hand or as part of the SDK-style conversion). Review transitive dependencies afterwards.

findings.title: NuGet package needs a major upgrade or swap to its ASP.NET Core variant
findings.guidance: Upgrade to a version that supports netstandard2.0/net8+ or switch to the .AspNetCore / .Extensions.DependencyInjection variant.

occurrences.snippet: log4net 2.0.8 upgrade to 2.0.10+ (or move to Microsoft.Extensions.Logging)

findings.title: HttpRuntime.Cache / System.Web.Caching
findings.guidance: Replace with IMemoryCache / IDistributedCache.

findings.title: System.Data.SqlClient
findings.guidance: Switch to Microsoft.Data.SqlClient (note: Encrypt=true is the default, which may require TrustServerCertificate or proper certificates).

projects.name: LegacyShop.Web
projects.recommendedTarget: New ASP.NET Core app (Blazor or Razor Pages). Migrate page by page behind YARP, share auth/session via System.Web adapters.

findings.title: ASP.NET Web Forms pages
findings.guidance: Web Forms does not exist on modern .NET. Rewrite the UI (Blazor or Razor Pages). Migrate incrementally: put an ASP.NET Core app with YARP in front, move pages one by one, and share session/auth with System.Web adapters.

findings.title: ASP.NET Membership / Forms Authentication / Roles
findings.guidance: Move to ASP.NET Core Identity (or an external IdP). Plan the user/password-hash data migration and keep a compatible password hasher so users do not need to reset passwords.

findings.title: Web Forms user controls / master pages
findings.guidance: Rewrite as Blazor components / Razor layouts and partials.

findings.title: WCF client / service references
findings.guidance: Regenerate clients with dotnet-svcutil (System.ServiceModel.* packages). Only some bindings are supported (basicHttp, netTcp, wsHttp partially); check each endpoint's binding.

findings.title: ASP.NET Session state (usage or out-of-process mode)
findings.guidance: ASP.NET Core session is different (no SQLServer/StateServer modes, values are byte[]). During incremental migration share session via System.Web adapters.

findings.title: Custom IHttpModule / IHttpHandler
findings.guidance: Rewrite as ASP.NET Core middleware or endpoints.

findings.title: Global.asax application events
findings.guidance: Move Application_Start/Error/BeginRequest logic into Program.cs and middleware.

findings.title: NuGet package not supported on modern .NET (needs replacement)
findings.guidance: Find the ASP.NET Core / modern replacement for each listed package family.

findings.title: Legacy (non-SDK) project format
findings.guidance: Convert to SDK-style csproj (by hand or with Microsoft's upgrade tooling). Do this first; it makes every later step easier and can be done while still targeting net48.

findings.title: packages.config NuGet format
findings.guidance: Migrate to PackageReference (Visual Studio: right-click packages.config → Migrate; not offered for ASP.NET web projects, convert those by hand or as part of the SDK-style conversion). Review transitive dependencies afterwards.

findings.title: Server.MapPath / HostingEnvironment
findings.guidance: Use IWebHostEnvironment.ContentRootPath / WebRootPath.

projects.name: LegacyShop.Services
projects.recommendedTarget: CoreWCF on net10.0 (keeps contracts/clients) or redesign as gRPC / REST.

findings.title: WCF service hosting (.svc / system.serviceModel services)
findings.guidance: Server-side WCF is not part of modern .NET. Options: CoreWCF (closest, keeps contracts and clients), or redesign to gRPC / REST. Choose per client: who consumes this service and can they change?

findings.title: ASMX web services
findings.guidance: Not supported on modern .NET. Re-implement as Web API endpoints or host with CoreWCF (basicHttpBinding) to keep the SOAP contract for existing clients.

findings.title: Legacy (non-SDK) project format
findings.guidance: Convert to SDK-style csproj (by hand or with Microsoft's upgrade tooling). Do this first; it makes every later step easier and can be done while still targeting net48.

projects.name: LegacyShop.Admin
projects.recommendedTarget: ASP.NET Core MVC on net10.0. Large apps: incremental migration with YARP + System.Web adapters.

findings.title: ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web.Mvc)
findings.guidance: Move controllers to ASP.NET Core MVC. Most action code ports with small changes; filters, model binders, bundling, routing and HtmlHelpers need rework.

findings.title: ASP.NET Identity 2 / OWIN auth
findings.guidance: Move to ASP.NET Core Identity. Schema is similar but not identical; plan a migration script.

findings.title: ASP.NET Web API 2 (System.Web.Http)
findings.guidance: Port ApiControllers to ASP.NET Core controllers. Check message handlers, formatters and OWIN middleware.

findings.title: Global.asax application events
findings.guidance: Move Application_Start/Error/BeginRequest logic into Program.cs and middleware.

findings.title: NuGet package not supported on modern .NET (needs replacement)
findings.guidance: Find the ASP.NET Core / modern replacement for each listed package family.

occurrences.snippet: Microsoft.Owin.Security.Cookies 4.1.0 OWIN middleware → ASP.NET Core middleware

findings.title: Legacy (non-SDK) project format

findings.title: Razor views (MVC 5)
findings.guidance: Views usually port with small changes: replace @Html/@Url helpers, bundling (@Scripts/@Styles) and child actions with tag helpers / view components.

findings.title: NuGet package needs a major upgrade or swap to its ASP.NET Core variant
findings.guidance: Upgrade to a version that supports netstandard2.0/net8+ or switch to the .AspNetCore / .Extensions.DependencyInjection variant.

projects.name: LegacyShop.Reports
projects.recommendedTarget: Multi-target net48;net10.0 (or netstandard2.0) once its major and blocker findings are resolved.

findings.title: Crystal Reports / ReportViewer
findings.guidance: No direct support on modern .NET web. Options: keep a small .NET Framework reporting service, move to SSRS/Power BI embedding, or a .NET reporting library.

findings.title: Thread.Abort / Suspend / Resume
findings.guidance: Throws PlatformNotSupportedException. Use CancellationToken-based cooperative cancellation.

findings.title: Legacy (non-SDK) project format

findings.title: Targets an old .NET Framework version (< 4.7.2)
findings.guidance: Retarget to net48 first. It gives netstandard2.0 compatibility and lets you share libraries with the new .NET app during an incremental migration.

findings.title: Windows-only APIs (Registry, System.Drawing, EventLog, WMI)
findings.guidance: Fine on Windows. If you plan to run on Linux/containers, these need replacing (e.g. System.Drawing → ImageSharp/SkiaSharp).
